definitions.explanation: Steamed rice that has been inoculated with koji mold (Aspergillus oryzae), used as a fermentation starter in making sake, miso, soy sauce, and other traditional Japanese foods.

examples.japanese: {米麹|こめこうじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{甘酒|あまざけ}→甘酒：13519_amazake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I make amazake with rice koji.

{米麹|こめこうじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発酵食品|はっこうしょくひん}→発酵食品：16504_hakkoushokuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧だ。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ (rice) + ⟦{麹|こうじ}→麹：18900_kouji⟧ (koji mold). Rice koji is the foundation of many traditional Japanese fermented products and is sometimes called Japan's "national mold."
